lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12-15 high-luminance circular spots arranged in visible vertical columns of 3-4 nodes each, located posterior to the gills and dorsal to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: At least five primary vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, with circular spots positioned as nodes at the intersections of these bands and horizontal axes, forming a grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper-mid lateral flank, exhibiting a distinct luminance gradient with light scattering on the dorsal aspect and shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-luminance, elongated remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral region near the posterior insertion of the pectoral fin.
